Your environment is protected by a managed security baseline: an agreed set of security policies and settings that we deploy, check continuously, and repair when anything drifts out of line. This report shows where that baseline stands today, what we will change next, and why each choice was made.

Every protection in the baseline is listed below with its current state. In place means it is deployed and verified as correct. Being corrected means it drifted from the agreed value and is covered in the changes on the next pages. First check pending means it was recently assigned - what it will apply is already listed in the changes on the next pages, and the first verification run confirms it.
